description: This Scala source file defines utility functions for mapping Spark SQL data types to JDBC types, class names, and properties such as precision, scale, and display size. It is part of the Spark SQL connect JDBC utility package.

classes.name: JdbcTypeUtils
classes.description: Object containing utility methods for mapping Spark SQL data types to JDBC types and properties.

methods.name: getColumnType
methods.description: Returns the JDBC type code for a given Spark StructField based on its data type.

methods.name: getColumnTypeClassName
methods.description: Returns the Java class name corresponding to the Spark data type of the StructField.

methods.name: isSigned
methods.description: Indicates whether the data type is signed.

methods.name: getPrecision
methods.description: Returns the precision for the data type.

methods.name: getScale
methods.description: Returns the scale for the data type.

methods.name: getDisplaySize
methods.description: Returns the display size for the data type.

methods.name: getDecimalDigits
methods.description: Returns the number of decimal digits for the data type.

methods.name: getNumPrecRadix
methods.description: Returns the numeric precision radix for the data type.

search-terms: Spark SQL data type to JDBC mapping
